instruction:
Please act as a professional Verilog designer. Implement a pipelined 6-to-1 multiplexer that selects one of the six input data based on a 3-bit select signal. 
If the select signal is not between 0 and 5, the output should be set to the value of the input data corresponding to the most significant bit. 
The data inputs and outputs are all 4 bits wide. Use a pipeline structure to achieve this functionality.
